# Collapse

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Skills affected:** Groundshaker
- **Mechanic tags:** breakpoint, step-function, rhythm, damage-pool
- **Last verified:** 2026-07-01 by owner
- **Backlog:** `DEMOLISHER-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Setup

**Groundshaker** vs the standard Lv85 dummy (see [training-dummy](training-dummy.md)). Frequent-Quake persistence + auto/rhythm casting must both be active (Collapse only builds while the max-spread fissure persists). Data below taken at Collapse roll ≈ 62%.

Vary the **Rhythm interval R** (seconds between casts) one step at a time and read the Collapse bonus off the Demolisher panel / Recount.

## Raw data points

Rhythm sweep (roll ≈ 62%), observed Collapse bonus:

- R = 1.5 → +33% (floor 1)
- R = 1.2 → +31% (floor 1)
- R = 1.0 → +31% (floor 1)
- R = 0.9 → +32.3% (floor 1, pins L = 1.6, step at R = 0.8)
- R = 0.8 → ~+51–58% (floor 1↔2 boundary, time-averaged)
- R = 0.7 → +61% (floor 2)
- R = 0.6 → +63% (floor 2)
- R = 0.5 → +97% (floor 3)
- R = 0.4 → +100.4% (floor 3↔4 boundary)

## Derived / confirmed formula

`Collapse% = floor(1.6 / R) × 0.5 × roll`

- Fissure lifetime **L = 1.6 s** (pinned by the R = 0.9 data point).
- Floor boundaries fall at **R = 1.6 / n**; only R = 0.8 and R = 0.4 land on selectable rhythms, so those two time-average between adjacent floors.
- Past the breakpoint Collapse is **cdr-independent**; the rhythm breakpoint is **cdr = 3/R − 1**.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Gated on Frequent-Quake persistence + auto/rhythm overlap. The two boundary rhythms (0.8, 0.4) read as a time-average of the floors on either side. Re-confirm opportunistically alongside the rest of DEMOLISHER-01.
